findings.description: Hair transitions from hanging calm (00:00-00:04) to being vigorously blown backward and upward (00:06 onward) with no visible cause: the car's speed relative to the road and poles appears unchanged, no other wind source is introduced, and the environment (brush, poles) shows no corresponding gust. The wind effect switches on late rather than building with the vehicle's existing forward motion.
